entries.zh: 上午十点钟（日间十时，「小午」时分）
entries.en: ten o'clock in the morning
entries.notes: 四栏均带[疑]；据西语栏昼间十点与汉字栏「日小午」定时义释之。

entries.zh: 夜间十点至十一点之间（晚十至十一时）
entries.en: from ten to eleven o'clock at night
entries.notes: 汉字栏「雞」后一字吁/鳴两读存疑，按西语栏夜间时点义释之。

entries.zh: 一万年
entries.en: ten thousand years

entries.zh: 抽取十分之一；什一抽分（抽税）
entries.en: to tithe, to take one tenth

entries.zh: 差；差别、相差，又指差错
entries.en: difference, to differ; (as) error, to err
entries.notes: 原页有墨漬致 M/R 栏受损；据汉字「差」与 M 栏西文夹注 errar 释之。

entries.zh: 物之类别；种类、品类
entries.en: class, kind of things; sort

entries.zh: 别；分别，人与人或物与物之间的差别
entries.en: difference between men or things; to distinguish

entries.zh: 级；品级，爵位官阶高下之差
entries.en: difference in rank or dignity; grade
entries.notes: 汉字栏形近「給」而音写 quîp/guīp（kip）合「級」，按品级义释之。

entries.zh: 殊；殊异，方式之不同
entries.en: different, differing in manner

entries.zh: 异；不同，相异之事物
entries.en: different thing; difference

entries.zh: 矛盾；人事或事物互相抵触不合
entries.en: contradiction; discord, mutual conflict
entries.notes: 汉字栏首字矛/茅两读存疑，据音写与西义定为「矛盾」。

entries.zh: 各样；种种不同，各色各样
entries.en: various; of different sorts

entries.zh: 走精；走样、失准，偏离本真
entries.en: to go wrong, deviate from what is right
entries.notes: 「走精」为闽南习语（走样失准），西栏括注 Diferencia。

entries.zh: 差不多；相差无几
entries.en: about the same; more or less
entries.notes: 西语栏 Diferencia puca 之 puca 难以确解，据汉字栏与音写释为「差不多」。

entries.zh: 分别；区分辨别
entries.en: to distinguish, tell apart; difference

entries.zh: 异样；样式不同
entries.en: different in kind or appearance

entries.zh: 异常；异于平常
entries.en: unusual, extraordinary; differing from the norm

entries.zh: 各人各别；你们各人各不相同
entries.en: each of you different, one from another
entries.notes: 汉字栏首二字释读存疑，按西语 cada uno de vos 释之。

entries.zh: 当路（当行之路）
entries.en: the road one should take; the Spanish note (different path, and immorality) is unreconciled with the Chinese
entries.notes: 西语栏（别途、且涉不道德之行）与汉字栏「当路」语义相左，语义无法定夺，降为低置信。

entries.zh: 太野形；衣着打扮与他人迥异，过于出格
entries.en: differently dressed from the rest; outlandish in attire
